_review: NEEDS NATIVE-SPEAKER REVIEW. This file exists because the Monlam dictionary is a word dictionary, not a phrasebook: 'hello' and 'how are you' return no result at all, and words like 'mother', 'good' and 'beautiful' come back in literary register (མ, དགེ་བ་བྱ་བ, བཀྲ་བ) rather than the colloquial forms a beginner should actually say. These 20 phrases and 6 colloquial words cover exactly that gap. Everything here is asserted by the tutor as fact, so an error propagates to every learner — please check before this is shown to anyone.
_phonetic_note: Phonetics are practical spoken (Lhasa) pronunciation, NOT Wylie transliteration. Wylie read aloud misleads beginners: 'bkra shis bde legs' is pronounced 'tashi delek'.
